claims.content: The Customer clicks the 'Create New Auctions' link in the Auction Administration interface.

The system displays the successfully listed personal jewelry in the Auction Administration interface as a scheduled auction (status 'Scheduled', blue row highlighting) with populated fields/columns: Product ID, Auction #, Description, Open Bid, High Bid, Unit Cost, Starts, Ends, Duration, Product Type, and Increment; the item is shown in a searchable table of scheduled auctions in the Search Results section.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to list personal jewelry for auction on the JTVauctions.com stand-alone auction site.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer creates a new auction listing for a personal jewelry item by populating the structured SKU creation form with product details (jewelry attributes, primary gemstone specifications, and accent stone details), setting auction parameters (start/end times, duration, bid increments), and submitting the listing via the Create New Auction button in the Auction Administration interface.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer starts creating a new auction listing for a personal jewelry item in the Auction Administration interface.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has submitted the listing via the Create New Auction button; the personal jewelry item is listed for auction.
in_scope_actions: Populating the structured SKU creation form with product details (jewelry attributes such as Product Type, Brand, Metal Purity; primary gemstone specifications such as Gemstone, Stone Group, CTW; accent stone details such as Accent Stone 1 Stone, Color, Shape)
Setting auction parameters (start/end times, duration, bid increments)
Submitting the listing via the Create New Auction button
excluded_adjacent_actions: Managing the auction after it has been listed
variant_dimensions: Selectable starting categories on the homepage: Jewelry, Gemstones, Product Type (e.g., Rings, Necklaces, Bracelets)
